services.desc: Enjoy a private guided tour of River Bend Nature Center with coworkers, friends, or family! Private Group Tours are a great way for small groups of all ages to discover the Nature Center, get an introduction to local plants and wildlife, and learn about our dual mission of conservation and education. Reserve your tour today by filling out the form below.
